summary: Guardian Money CHF - Frontend Testing Complete. All screens load successfully, navigation works, but seed data loading has issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Demo mode button clicks successfully but seed data does NOT load. After activation, expenses show 'Aucune dépense', savings show 'Aucun objectif', and patrimoine shows CHF 0. The loadSeedData() function is not working properly.
Add transaction modal does not open when clicking the + button. Button click is not triggering the modal.
Add savings goal modal does not open when clicking the + button. Button click is not triggering the modal.

integration_issues.issue: Zustand store's loadSeedData() is not populating transactions, savings goals, and other financial data after demo mode activation. Console shows 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module' error from useStore.ts polyfill.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error: 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module'. The polyfill code in useStore.ts (lines 11-20) is causing errors. This may be preventing proper Zustand store initialization and persistence.

action_items: Fix import.meta polyfill in /app/frontend/src/stores/useStore.ts - Remove or fix lines 11-20 that are causing module errors
Verify loadSeedData() is properly called and executed when demo mode is activated in auth.tsx
Add testID attributes to add buttons in expenses.tsx and savings.tsx for better testing
Test seed data loading after fixing the import.meta issue
Verify Zustand persistence is working correctly with AsyncStorage
critical_code_review_comments: useStore.ts lines 11-20: The import.meta polyfill is causing errors. This should be removed or properly configured for web builds.
auth.tsx handleDemoMode: Verify that loadSeedData() is being called correctly and that the store is updating state properly.
All screens are missing testID attributes on interactive elements (buttons, inputs). Add testID props for better testing.
The app works well for navigation and UI rendering, but state management needs attention.

success_rate.frontend: 75% - All screens load and navigate correctly, but seed data loading and some modals are not working

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. App has built-in seed data in /app/frontend/src/data/seed-data.ts but it's not loading properly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The app is a Swiss personal finance app with excellent UI and all screens loading correctly. Main issue is Zustand store not loading seed data when demo mode is activated. Console shows 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module' error from useStore.ts. Fix the polyfill code and verify loadSeedData() execution. All navigation works, Swiss Tax Optimizer and LAMal Comparator are functional. The app uses Expo Router for navigation and Zustand with AsyncStorage for state management.
rca_of_issue: Root Cause: The import.meta polyfill in useStore.ts (lines 11-20) is causing a JavaScript error 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module'. This error may be preventing proper Zustand store initialization, which in turn prevents loadSeedData() from executing correctly when demo mode is activated. The polyfill was likely added to handle ESM compatibility but is not working in the web build environment. Solution: Remove the polyfill code or use a proper build-time solution for handling import.meta in web environments.
